subject: psychiatry
title: Sexual Dysfunction, Paraphilic Disorders, and Gender Dysphoria

steps.tx: **Erectile dysfunction** is defined as the consistent or recurrent inability to attain or maintain an erection sufficient for satisfactory sexual performance, persisting for at least six months. The diagnostic workup distinguishes psychogenic etiology, featuring abrupt situational onset and preserved morning erections, from organic vascular, neurogenic, or endocrine causes.
steps.say: Erectile dysfunction is the inability to maintain an erection for six months. Preserved morning tumescence confirms a psychogenic over organic etiology.

left.title: Psychogenic Etiology
points: Abrupt, sudden onset following psychological stress
Preserved nocturnal and early morning erections
Situational: fails with partner, normal with masturbation
High performance anxiety and fear of failure

right.title: Organic Etiology
points: Complete loss of nocturnal and morning erections

steps.tx: **Phosphodiesterase-5 inhibitors**, such as sildenafil, tadalafil, and vardenafil, represent the first-line oral medical pharmacotherapy for erectile dysfunction. Sildenafil competitively inhibits the PDE-5 enzyme, preventing the catalytic degradation of cyclic guanosine monophosphate (cGMP) in the corpus cavernosum, which maintains vascular smooth muscle relaxation and tumescence.
steps.say: Sildenafil inhibits PDE-5 to prevent cGMP breakdown in the corpus cavernosum, sustaining vascular smooth muscle relaxation and penile erection.

nodes.label: Sexual stimulation triggers cavernosal nitric oxide release
Guanosine triphosphate converted to cyclic GMP via guanylyl cyclase
Sildenafil blocks PDE-5, preventing enzymatic cGMP breakdown

steps.tx: **Nitrate contraindication with sildenafil** represents an absolute, life-threatening pharmacological rule: administering PDE-5 inhibitors concurrently with organic nitrates like nitroglycerin or isosorbide dinitrate causes catastrophic, refractory systemic vasodilation and fatal hypotension. Co-administration within 24 hours of sildenafil or 48 hours of tadalafil is strictly contraindicated.
steps.say: Combining sildenafil with nitroglycerin causes fatal hypotension and cardiovascular collapse. Concurrent nitrate therapy is an absolute contraindication.

steps.tx: **Premature ejaculation** is defined as a persistent pattern of ejaculation occurring within approximately one minute of vaginal penetration, before the individual wishes, causing clinically significant distress. Management combines behavioral techniques, such as the Semans stop-start method and Masters and Johnson squeeze technique, with short-acting serotonergic agents.
steps.say: Premature ejaculation occurs within one minute of penetration. It is treated with behavioral pause techniques and short-acting dapoxetine.

left.title: Behavioral Therapies
points: Masters and Johnson glans squeeze technique

right.title: Pharmacological Therapies
points: Tramadol taken as an on-demand rescue agent

steps.tx: **Vaginismus and female sexual pain disorders** involve involuntary, persistent muscular spasm of the outer third of the vagina and pelvic floor musculature (pubococcygeus) upon attempted vaginal entry. Coitus is rendered impossible or excruciatingly painful, successfully managed through progressive graded vaginal dilators, pelvic physical therapy, and relaxation training.
steps.say: Vaginismus is an involuntary pelvic floor muscle spasm preventing vaginal entry, successfully treated with progressive dilators and relaxation training.

nodes.label: Psychoeducation to demystify pelvic anatomy and involuntary spasm
Pelvic floor progressive muscle relaxation & Kegel biofeedback
Graduated self-insertion of silicone vaginal dilators (sizes 1 to 5)
Gradual transition to partner coital attempts without fear

steps.tx: **Sensate focus therapy**, devised by Masters and Johnson, systematically eliminates performance anxiety in couples through structured, progressive physical intimacy assignments. Partners are initially strictly forbidden from engaging in genital touching or intercourse, focusing exclusively on non-genital tactile caressing to foster mutual intimacy.
steps.say: Sensate focus eliminates performance anxiety through non-genital touching exercises, with sexual intercourse strictly banned in early phases.

vis.title: Masters and Johnson Sensate Focus Stages
rows: Strictly no breast, genital touching, or coitus
Strictly no orgasm pursuit or coital penetration
No performance demand or thrusting goals
Mutual pelvic thrusting to natural climax
Free coital intimacy without performance anxiety

steps.tx: **Paraphilic disorders** are distinguished from benign non-pathological paraphilias by the mandatory presence of personal distress, functional impairment, or sexual activity involving non-consenting individuals. Major paraphilic entities include fetishism (arousal from inanimate objects), exhibitionism (flashing unsuspecting strangers), voyeurism (peeping), and frotteurism (touching non-consenting strangers).
steps.say: Paraphilic disorders require atypical sexual interests causing distress, impairment, or harm to non-consenting victims, such as voyeurism and exhibitionism.

vis.title: DSM-5 Paraphilic Entities
rows: Public offense; high risk of legal arrest
Touching or rubbing against non-consenting persons
Severe criminal felony; mandatory protective reporting

steps.tx: **Gender dysphoria** involves a marked, persistent incongruence between an individual's experienced or expressed gender and their assigned biological sex at birth, lasting at least six months and causing significant distress. Management encompasses affirmative social transition, gender-affirming hormone therapy, and gender confirmation surgery under multi-disciplinary mental health supervision.
steps.say: Gender dysphoria involves marked incongruence between experienced gender and assigned sex lasting six months, managed with affirmative care and hormonal therapy.

left.title: Diagnostic Criteria
points: Marked incongruence lasting at least 6 months
Desire to be rid of primary/secondary sex features
Desire for sexual characteristics of experienced gender
Clinically significant subjective distress or impairment
